 Coram:

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is an application U/S.483 of the BNSS by the petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Badagada P.S. Case No.556 of 2025 corresponding to T.R. Case No.588 of 2025 pending in the Court of learned Special Judge (POCSO)-cum-Addl. Sessions Judge, Bhubaneswar, for commission of offence punishable U/Ss. 363/376(1)/323/506/34 of IPC r/w. Sec.4(2) of the POCSO Act, on the main allegation of kidnapping the victim and committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon her.
3. Heard Mr. Gorekhnath Das, learned counsel for the petitioner, Mr. S.C. Pradhan, learned Addl.
PP and Mr. Sandeep Raj Panda, learned counsel for the informant in the matter and perused the record.
4.

Mr. Das by filing a comprehensive affidavit informs this Court that the petitioner is having 16 nos.
of criminal antecedents, however, the allegation against the petitioner in this case is not only serious, but also grave.
Further, it is submitted that in the meantime, charge sheet has already been submitted.

Right to fair trial includes fair trial to the victim also, but in this case, the number of criminal antecedents as shown against the petitioner itself is an impediment against the right to fair trial for the victim, if the accused petitioner is released on bail.
